drivingQuestion: What is the woman's status during the days before the condition is fulfilled?
outcomeNote: mishna; dispute between R' Yehuda and R' Yosei stands

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ לֹא תִּתְיַיחֵד עִמּוֹ אֶלָּא בִּפְנֵי עֵדִים,
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If a woman’s ill husband gave her a bill of divorce, and made a condition that it should take effect from today if he dies from his illness, then «she may be secluded with him only in the presence of two witnesses,» lest they end up engaging in sexual intercourse.

segments.he: אֲפִילּוּ עַל פִּי עֶבֶד אֲפִילּוּ עַל פִּי שִׁפְחָה; חוּץ מִשִּׁפְחָתָהּ, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁלִּבָּהּ גַּס בָּהּ בְּשִׁפְחָתָהּ.
segments.en: This applies to being secluded in the presence of not only valid witnesses; it is permitted for her to be secluded with him «even in the presence of a slave» or «even in the presence of a maidservant, except for» the wife’s personal «maidservant.» And it is prohibited for the wife to be secluded in the presence of the latter «because she is accustomed to her maidservant,» and there is concern that she will engage in sexual intercourse with her husband even though the maidservant is present.

segments.he: מָה הִיא בְּאוֹתָן הַיָּמִים? רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר:
segments.en: «What is» the halakhic status of the wife «during these days» between when the bill of divorce was given but before the condition has been fulfilled with the death of the husband? «Rabbi Yehuda says:» She is

segments.he: כְּאֵשֶׁת אִישׁ לְכׇל דְּבָרֶיהָ. רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר: מְגוֹרֶשֶׁת וְאֵינָהּ מְגוֹרֶשֶׁת.
segments.en: «like a married woman with regard to all of her matters,» and she remains forbidden to other men. «Rabbi Yosei says:» It is uncertain whether «she is divorced or» whether «she is not divorced.»

moves.cueHe: לא תתייחד עמו אלא בפני עדים
moves.summary: She may be secluded with him only before witnesses.
Even a slave or maidservant suffices, except her own maidservant.
What is her status in those days?
Like a married woman in all respects.
moves.about: the status of a woman during the days between a conditional deathbed divorce and the husband's death

edges.about: the status of a woman during the days between a conditional deathbed divorce and the husband's death
